verdict.rationale: Unity exposes extensive scripting/editor extension APIs (custom inspectors, editor windows, property drawers), command-line/CLI automation, a Unity CLI for CI, and an official MCP server for LLM-driven natural-language automation, giving strong programmatic access to editor functionality (unity-docs-6,7,10,11,23,24,25,unity-probe-4). However, there's no explicit documentation claiming full 1:1 parity between UI and API/CLI/MCP coverage, and some editor workflows remain UI-centric with no stated guarantee every UI action has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, independent verification of comprehensive coverage, and confirmation that all editor UI features (not just common workflows) are scriptable.
